ody.text: The Cabal is founded by Virot Maglan, who becomes the First, and after the Phyrexian Invasion its pit fights grow in popularity, greatly expanding its wealth and influence.
It controls most of the land and wealth, running pit fights for the masses while the Order strives to break its iron fist over the populace.

Chainer finds the Mirari and gives it to the First as a tournament prize, then usurps rulership of the Cabal, but he loses control of the Mirari's power in a pit fight against Kamahl, and Cabal City is condemned and abandoned.
After Chainer's death the First regains control of the Cabal from Aphetto and plans the Grand Coliseum, and later Cabal forces led by Braids murder Seton and abduct Jeska.

jud.text: The Cabal's schemes spread beyond the pits, as Braids pockets the Mirari, immune to its lure, and returns it to the First, and Laquatus plays an Order contingent led by Eesha and a Cabal battalion led by Braids against each other.
When Cabal troops attack a village the barbarians unite and win, and Eesha declares that the aven will not be victims of treachery, the Cabal or their own ambitions again.
Braids helps Phage and Kuberr survive an assassination attempt and kills the Cabal Patriarch with a nightmare beast, after which the reincarnated Kuberr takes over the Cabal.
After Karona's War the Cabal is left with no leader and no god and is presumed defunct around 4500 AR.

ons.text: The Cabal strips Ixidor and abandons him in the desert after discovering his forged coins, and in his heartbreak he shapes Akroma from his dream, charging her to avenge Nivea.
Nivea died at the hands of Phage in a Cabal pit fight, and Cabal healing magic transforms Jeska into Phage, a pit fighter whose touch brings death.
Akroma then leads Ixidor's armies against the Cabal, who with Kamahl's Krosans track her to Topos.
Kamahl declares war on Ixidor and leads the Cabal and Krosan alliance in the Nightmare War, and afterward Akroma seizes Topos's ruins and the Cabal withdraws.
